proposal.summary: CM550's torque derate fuel limit chain has the same design as CM848's: a runner (0x30c3c - counterpart of CM848 0x4280c) calls an initializer and one small limiter per derate source, and each limiter compares its limit record with the running minimum FSLMFL (e2m 105D +0 - CM848's torque_derate_fuel_quantity) or the group 2 air handling minimum (105D +6) and stamps its FUELING_STATE number. Seven of the nine dumped steps are instruction-for-instruction twins of CM848 functions (initializer 19 / 40, power take-off torque limit 34, air fuel control 16, altitude 15, fault derate 29, TSC1 torque limit 20, fuel system derate 28); two exist only in CM550 and name their members: the acceleration noise control fuel limit (17 - Calterm ANCDERAT) and the engine warmup protection fuel limit (33 - ESUOILLM). The runner's only caller 0x1c152 is the final fueling selection (requested fueling - engine state overrides - clamp): CM848's cm848_arbitrateRequestedFueling plus cm848_selectFinalFueling in one function. The second chain (0x30b34) is not a fuel chain: it is the injection timing modification chain on TSOI (e2m 103B +2) - misfire limit, AFC advance, cylinder pressure maintenance increment, wet stack advance, ANC limit, maximum limit and cranking timing - each stamping the Calterm timing state. The remaining functions are unrelated to the chains: the fuel shutoff driver command, two start-up initializers (idle adjustment and trip information), the hour meter task (twin of cm848_advanceHourMeters) and an empty stub (skipped). Of the other unidentified members 18 / 37 / 38 get names from the code that compares them plus the e2m (never stored), and 3 / 36 / 39 stay unidentified with the reading in the comment.

functions.role: Lowers the running fuel derate minimum FSLMFL (0x80dec8) to the acceleration noise control fuel limit NZFLLM (0x80a28c) and stamps fueling state 17 into FSLMFLST (0x80deca) when that limit is the lower one.
functions.discriminator: The only limiter of the chain that reads NZFLLM and the only store of state 17 in the ROM (move.w #0x11 at 0xb3c6); its siblings read other limit records and stamp 15 / 16 / 20 / 28 / 29 / 33.
functions.plate_comment: Step 3 of the fuel limit chains (cm550_runFuelLimitChains): when acceleration_noise_control_fuel_limit (e2m 10A4 +0 NZFLLM) is below torque_derate_fuel_quantity (105D +0 FSLMFL) it becomes the minimum and torque_derate_fuel_source_code is set to FUELING_STATE_ACCELERATION_NOISE_CONTROL_DERATE (17 - Calterm ANCDERAT). CM848 has no such step (was cm550_shutdownMinimumSelector21: the 21 was wrong - it stamps 17).
functions.evidence: 0xb3b2 movea.l #0x80dec8,a1 / 0xb3b8 movea.l #0x80a28c,a0 / 0xb3be move.w (a0),d0 / 0xb3c0 cmp.w (a1),d0 / 0xb3c2 bcc.s 0xb3ce (unsigned: skip unless limit < minimum) / 0xb3c4 move.w (a0),(a1) / 0xb3c6 move.w #0x11,(0x80deca).l / rts. Only caller: jsr at 0x30c48, the third call of the chain runner 0x30c3c. e2m v64t6_s: 10A4 +0 NZFLLM 'FUELING LIMIT AS DETERMINED BY THE ANC FEATURE'; group ACCNOISE 'ACCELERATION NOISE CONTROL GROUP' with NZFLAGEN 'ENABLE FOR FUEL LIMITING OF THE ACCELERATION NOISE C(ONTROL)'. NZFLLM is computed by the function at 0xb2aa and preset to FSMXFL at 0xb632. CM848: the runner 0x4280c calls 0xe0c4 (state 16) right after 0x2a918 (state 34) - no step here, no record with mnemonic NZFLLM in the labelled CM848 e2m, no member 17. RAM dump: NZFLLM 5888 (no limit).

functions.role: Saves the working timing advance TSOI (0x80d346) into TSBENZTA (0x80a29e), then lowers TSOI to the acceleration noise control timing limit NZTALM (0x80a28e) and stamps timing state 3 into TSTPTAST (0x80d348) when that limit is lower.
functions.discriminator: The only step of the timing chain that reads NZTALM and writes TSBENZTA, and the only store of timing state 3 (move.w #0x3 at 0xb4e8). The fuel limit sibling 0xb3b2 handles NZFLLM and the fueling state instead.
functions.plate_comment: Step 5 of the injection timing modification chain (cm550_runInjectionTimingModificationChain): copies fuel_timing_advance_value (e2m 103B +2 TSOI) to 10A4 +12 TSBENZTA and - when acceleration_noise_control_timing_limit (10A4 +2 NZTALM) is below it - lowers the timing to that limit with intermediate timing state 3 (Calterm ANC). It limits timing not fuel (was cm550_fuelDemandLimitMinimumUpdater).
functions.evidence: 0xb4ce movea.l #0x80d346,a1 / 0xb4d4 movea.l #0x80a28e,a0 / 0xb4da move.w (a1),(0x80a29e).l / 0xb4e0 move.w (a0),d0 / 0xb4e2 cmp.w (a1),d0 / 0xb4e4 bcc.s 0xb4f0 / 0xb4e6 move.w (a0),(a1) / 0xb4e8 move.w #0x3,(0x80d348).l. Only caller: jsr at 0x30b4c in 0x30b34. e2m: 10A4 +2 NZTALM 'TIMING ADVANCE LIMIT AS DETERMINED BY ANC', 10A4 +12 TSBENZTA 'TIMING ADVANCE LIMIT AS JUST BEFORE MODIFICATION BY ANC TIMING', 103B +4 TSTPTAST 'INTERMEDIATE TIMING STATE'; the CHR e2m lists the timing state labels (03=ANC). CM848: no instruction references ANC_Timing 0x40a04a or SOI_Before_ANC_Timing 0x40a056 (scan of both images, and neither address appears in the decompilation); cm848_passCompensatedTimingToCombustionLimits 0x17b54 only copies a value at the ANC stage's place. RAM dump: NZTALM 1024.

functions.role: Lowers the group 2 (air handling) fuel minimum FLLMAHFL (0x80dece) to the air fuel control fuel limit AFFL (0x80a8f6) and stamps state 16 into FSLMAHST (0x80ded0) when the limit is lower.
functions.discriminator: The only limiter that works on the group 2 minimum (0x80dece / 0x80ded0) instead of the main minimum (0x80dec8 / 0x80deca); it reads AFFL and stamps 16.
functions.plate_comment: Twin of CM848 0xe0c4. Step 4 of the fuel limit chains: when air_fuel_control_fuel_limit (e2m 104C +0 AFFL) is below fuel_demand_minimum_tracked (105D +6 FLLMAHFL - the group 2 air handling minimum) it becomes that minimum and fuel_demand_minimum_tracked_state (105D +8 FSLMAHST) is set to FUELING_STATE_AIR_FUEL_CONTROL_DERATE (16) (was cm550_shutdownMinimumSelector16 / cm848_applyAirFuelControlFuelLimit).

Same three steps in the same order: read the limit, unsigned compare with the minimum, store the limit and state 16. Same records on both sides: AFFL 104C +0 (0x80a8f6 / 0x40a158), FLLMAHFL 105D +6 (0x80dece / 0x40afb2), FSLMAHST 105D +8 (0x80ded0 / 0x40afb4). RAM dump: AFFL 1236 = FLLMAHFL 1236 with state 16.

functions.role: Adds the signed air fuel control timing advance AFCNICTA (0x80de68) to the working timing advance TSOI (0x80d346) with a floor of 0 and copies the AFC increment status word 0x8000d6 into mask 4 of the timing increment flags TSSTIC (0x80d34a).
functions.discriminator: The only step that reads AFCNICTA and the only writer of TSSTIC mask 4; it adds to the timing and never stamps the timing state, unlike the limit steps (states 3 / 4 / 11).
functions.plate_comment: Step 2 of the injection timing modification chain: adds 105B +0 AFCNICTA (the timing advance added to base timing while air fuel control limits the fuel - 0xc2be sets it to the calibration 105C +0 AFICTA and the status word 0x8000d6 to 4 while final_fueling_state is 16) to fuel_timing_advance_value (103B +2 TSOI) with a floor of 0 and puts that status into bit 2 of timing_control_status_flags (103B +6 TSSTIC). CM848 has no code for the record.

Only caller: jsr at 0x30b3a in 0x30b34. Scored candidate CM848 0x37f28 is cm848_monitorChargingSystemVoltageHighAndLow: rejected. CM848 has the record (AFC_Timing_Increment 0x40a2e4) but no instruction references it in either image and the address does not appear in the decompilation.

functions.role: Stores the working timing advance TSOI into TSAJ4DTA (0x80aaa4), adds the signed cylinder pressure maintenance increment CPTAIC (0x80aa9e) to TSOI clamped to 0..0x400 and copies the status word 0x80021c into mask 8 of the timing increment flags TSSTIC.
functions.discriminator: The only step that reads CPTAIC and writes TSAJ4DTA, and the only writer of TSSTIC mask 8; the AFC sibling 0xc2ee uses AFCNICTA and mask 4 and has no upper clamp.
functions.plate_comment: Step 3 of the injection timing modification chain: saves fuel_timing_advance_value (103B +2 TSOI) as 1090 +8 TSAJ4DTA (the sum of the 4D / AFC / user and coolant advances) - adds 1090 +2 CPTAIC (the timing increment output by cylinder pressure maintenance) with the result clamped to 0..1024 counts - and copies cylinder_pressure_maintenance_status (0 or 8) into bit 3 of timing_control_status_flags (103B +6 TSSTIC). No CM848 counterpart.

Only caller: jsr at 0x30b40 in 0x30b34. 0x80021c is set to 8 at 0x1231c and cleared at 0x12460 / 0x12478 by the cylinder pressure maintenance code (function 0x11e5e). e2m 1090 +2 CPTAIC 'INCREMENT TIMING VALUE OUTPUT BY CYLINDER PRESSURE MAINTENANC(E)', 1090 +8 TSAJ4DTA 'SUM OF 4D, AFC, USER AND COOLANT ADVANCES'. The labelled CM848 e2m has no record with mnemonic CPTAIC / TSAJ4DTA.

functions.role: While engine_state is RUNNING and the warmup protection limit flag WPLMFG (0x80ccb2) is set, lowers the fuel derate minimum FSLMFL to the engine warmup protection fuel limit WPTQLM (0x80ccc6) and stamps state 33 into FSLMFLST when that limit is lower.
functions.discriminator: The only limiter gated by engine_state == 3 and WPLMFG, the only chain reader of WPTQLM and the only store of state 33 (move.w #0x21 at 0x17146).
functions.plate_comment: Step 9 of the fuel limit chains: with engine_state ENGINE_STATE_RUNNING and engine_warmup_protection_fuel_limiting_flag (e2m 11EA +0 WPLMFG) set it takes engine_warmup_protection_fuel_limit (11EA +14 WPTQLM - the engine speed table value of the warmup protection state machine 0x16dd4) as the derate minimum with FUELING_STATE_ENGINE_WARMUP_PROTECTION (33 - Calterm ESUOILLM) when it is below torque_derate_fuel_quantity. CM848 has no such step.
functions.evidence: 0x17120 movea.l #0x80dec8,a1 / 0x17126 movea.l #0x80ccc6,a0 / 0x1712c cmpi.w #0x3,(0x80d0c8).l ; bne out / 0x17136 tst.w (0x80ccb2).l ; beq out / 0x1713e move.w (a0),d0 ; cmp.w (a1),d0 ; bcc out / 0x17144 move.w (a0),(a1) / 0x17146 move.w #0x21,(0x80deca).l. Only caller: jsr at 0x30c64 in 0x30c3c. e2m group EWP_HDR 'ENGINE WARMUP PROTECTION GROUP': 11EA +0 WPLMFG 'FUEL IS BEING LIMITED BY ENGINE WARMUP PROTECTION WHEN 1', 11EA +14 WPTQLM 'CALCULATED TORQUE LIMIT OF ENGINE STARTUP SPEED LIMIT ALGORITH(M)'. WPTQLM is written by the state machine at 0x16dd4 (reset to FSMXFL at 0x16e22 / 0x16eb2 / 0x16fd4 / 0x1706a, set from an engine speed table at 0x17092) under the enable bit 0x803cb8 & 2 (engine_warmup_protection_enable). functions.role: Runs the fuel limit chains (or takes the calibrated torque derate override), takes the smaller of the governed fuel and the derate minimum as the requested fueling with its state, then selects the final fueling and final_fueling_state by engine state (stopped / shutdown / overspeed / fuel override / engine brake / cranking / reentry - else the arbitration with the group 2 minimum), clamps it to the minimum..maximum fueling and records the previous final state.
functions.discriminator: The only writer of the final fueling FSFNFL (0x80d32e) and of final_fueling_state from engine_state (stores of 26 / 27 / 25 / 23 / 24 / 22 / 11 at 0x1c1d0-0x1c28a) and the only caller of the chain runner 0x30c3c.
functions.plate_comment: Selects the final fueling (e2m 1051 +0 FSFNFL) and final_fueling_state (1051 +2 FSFNFLST): runs cm550_runFuelLimitChains and the torque limit conversion 0x1c0d4 (or takes torque_derate_override_fuel_quantity_cal with state 13 while torque_derate_override_enable is set) - stores requested_fueling / requested_fueling_state (1051 +4 / +6) as the smaller of adjusted_user_fueling and torque_derate_fuel_quantity - then picks the final fuel by engine_state (26 stopped = 0 / 27 shutdown / 25 overspeed / 23 fuel override / 24 engine brake / 22 cranking and the reentry floor / else 11 or the group 2 and master-slave arbitration 0x1c03c) clamped to fuel_demand_minimum..fuel_demand_maximum. It also folds the group 2 minimum into torque_derate_fuel_quantity - latches the low speed governor entry (104A +10) - and saves final_fueling_state_prev. CM848 splits this into cm848_arbitrateRequestedFueling 0x1e5a4 and cm848_selectFinalFueling 0x1e22c (was fuelTimingOilPressureModeController).

Caller: jsr at 0x1b5fe in the task set 0x1b5ce. functions.role: Sets or clears the fuel shutoff driver command (bit 0x20 of the output byte 0x80bcfb) - on while the key switch bit is set and no shutoff condition holds - but only while no override client holds the output (priority byte 0x80bd47 is 0).
functions.discriminator: The only code that both sets and clears bit 0x20 of 0x80bcfb from the key switch / FSAPFSCO / engine brake / overspeed conditions; the start-up code of mc68k_initializeDiscreteOutputDrivers only presets the bit.
functions.plate_comment: Commands the fuel shutoff driver (e2m 000E +2D DRFSEA bit 5 - enable = FSO on): clears the bit when the key switch (000E +0 bit 0 DSKYSWSS) is off - or the fuel system asks for shutoff (1091 +0 FSAPFSCO) - or engine_retarder_active_flag is set with algorithm_enable_flags_0_cal bit 0x40 (EBODEN) - or engine_state is OVERSPEED with overspeed_fuel_shutoff_enable (EPOSFSO); sets it otherwise. It writes only while fuel_shutoff_driver_override_priority (12A7 +2D DRFSPZ) is 0. CM848 has no counterpart (was cm550_fuelDemandLimitSelector11; the row at 0x1ca5c is the same body entered two instructions late).

(0x2d,a2) = 0x80bd47 and (0x5,a1) = 0x80bcfb. One caller: jsr at 0x1b63c in the task set that starts at 0x1b612. CM848: overspeed_fuel_shutoff_enable has no reader in either bank, no code tests mask 0x40 of algorithm_enable_flags_0_cal (the tests use 2 / 0x100 / 0x400 / 0x800 / 0x1000 / 0x2000 / 0x8000) and the labelled e2m has no FSAPFSCO record; it lists an FSO_Command output ([DRFSEA] 1577 +3 mask 0x40) but that block is outside the dumped parameter table - no counterpart found. functions.role: Starts both running fuel minimums at the 100 % throttle fueling FSMXTHFL (0x80d368): FSLMFL (0x80dec8) with state 19 in FSLMFLST and the group 2 minimum FLLMAHFL (0x80dece) with state 40 in FSLMAHST.
functions.discriminator: The only step that writes both minimums unconditionally and the only store of states 19 and 40 into the two chain state words; every other step compares before it writes.

proposal.notes: ENUM MEMBERS. Scans behind the 'never stored' wording: scratch scan_cm550_state_constants.py (every move.w #N / cmpi.w #N / moveq form with 3, 18, 36-39 against the nine typed carriers plus the untyped 0x80d33a and 0x80a98e) and scan_cm848_state_constants.py (every li / cmpwi / cmplwi with 37, 38, 49, 50 in both images). A store through a register copy cannot be excluded by a scan, and the undumped CM550 code (0x45252, 0x455c8, 0x49f32 are called from these chains) may store 3 / 18 / 36 / 39. 3 PSSPEED, 36 PTPDERAT and 39 T2DERAT are kept: the readings (progressive shift speed control; powertrain protection derate; Top2 transmission derate) rest on label prefixes, and PS and PTP have other expansions in the e2m family. If 37 / 38 are accepted as Top2, 39 is the same prefix and could follow as FUELING_STATE_TOP2_TRANSMISSION_DERATE. CM848 49 OFCSTATE and 50 AFRSTATE stay: only compared (49 at 0xee74 / 0xf548 in cm848_runOperatingModeSpeedGovernor with 16 / 19; 50 at 0x52a48c in cm848_calculateFuelPressureSetpoint with 16 / 58), no li 49 anywhere and no li 50 into a fueling state word - a class (air limited fueling), not an algorithm. CM848's enum header comment lists '(37 38 49 50)' as unidentified and the comment of 37 guesses a two-speed axle: both need the Top2 wording if 37 / 38 are renamed. CM848's EEC1 table has a case 3 (0xF1 group) though its enum has no member 3. RUNNER RELATION. 0x30c3c / 0x4280c are reported as counterparts because the step lists differ; if a build-specific call list counts as the same function the shared name would be runFuelLimitChains. Either way CM848's cm848_processProtectionLimits (0x4280c) and cm848_calculateProtectionRateLimited (0x1e4e8) carry the bare word protection: cm848_runFuelLimitChains and - for 0x1e4e8 with CM550 0x1c0d4 - applyTorqueDerateTorqueLimit would fit. LEADS OUTSIDE THE BATCH. 0x1c0d4 cm550_FUN_0001c0d4 = CM848 0x1e4e8: converts the torque limit TQDQTQ into fuel (TQDQTQ x (FSMTFLNP 0x80d370 - NLFL 0x80db1c) / MTMPRPFL 0x80db1a + NLFL, floor 0), lowers FSLMFL with the state TQDQTQST, then resets TQDQTQ = 0xFFFF / state 40 (CM848 resets in the caller instead); CM848's fuel_demand_filter_dimension (0x40aee6) is that MTMPRPFL record 'max torque at current rpm in foot-pounds'. 0x1c03c cm550_diagnosticFuelLimitInterpolator is the final fueling arbitration against the group 2 minimum with the master / slave override 32 (inline in CM848's cm848_arbitrateRequestedFueling). 0x1c308 cm550_FUN_0001c308 is the start-up initializer of the torque limit (0xFFFF / 40; jsr at 0x28972). Timing: 0x17cf0 cm550_engineModeTransitionStateUpdater is the cranking step of the timing chain (TSOI = CKTA 0x80d09a, state 5, TSSTIC = 0); 0xc2be is the AFC timing advance calculation; 0x30b62 vp44InjectionSystemStateController is the final timing selection (states 10 / 9 / 8 / 7, user override timing 0x804024 = e2m 125D +0 TSUOTA in the EEPROM mirror); 0x1c65e cm550_fuelDemandTableBlendCalculator is the 4D timing and looks like the twin of cm848_calculateFourDimensionalInjectionTiming 0x1e870 (user commanded timing with state 2 at 0x1c68c, map blend with state 0 at 0x1c76a, the user increment with TSSTIC = 1 at 0x1c794, copy to TSOI); 0x26ab8 is the misfire table lookup (counterpart of cm848_calculateInjectionTimingMainMisfireLimit 0x29e50); 0x34cc4 / 0x34d52 compute the wet stack timing (0x34cc4 is named vp44_liftPumpFuelDeliveryController). A timing state enum for 0x80d348 / 0x80d34c / 0x8036e2 is ready from the stores: 0 FOUR_D (0x1c76a), 1 WETSTACK / 13 WTSTCOOL (0x34d3c / 0x34d48), 2 USERCOMD (0x1c68c), 3 ANC (0xb4e8), 4 MAX (0x30b2a), 5 CRANK (0x17d1a), 7 USEROVRD (0x30bd4), 8 STOP (0x30bba), 9 OVERSPED (0x30baa), 10 SHUTDOWN (0x30b96), 11 MISFIRE (0x26b30) - the labels are in the CHR e2m (SOI_State / Final_Timing_State); CM848 splits the same numbering into INJECTION_TIMING_INTERMEDIATE_SOURCE and MAIN_INJECTION_TIMING_SOURCE. TSSTIC bits: 1 user increment, 4 AFC advance, 8 cylinder pressure maintenance. Warmup protection: 0x16dd4 cm550_highRpmEngineProtectionStateMachine is the engine warmup protection state machine and 0x1709e cm550_fuelTemperatureLimitingSecondary its start-up initializer; 0x80ccc8 (11EA +16 WPIHFG) and 0x80ccca (11EA +18 WPACFT) have no rows. Hour meters: 0x3452a cm550_FUN_0003452a loads both meters from the EEPROM mirror (0x803b3e / 0x803b50) and looks like the twin of cm848_loadHourMetersFromEeprom 0x5067bc. MID-BODY ROWS (no jsr / bsr / pointer reaches the address): 0x1ca5c vp44_canPinVp44StatusController, 0x2659a vp44_initVP44StatusFlags, 0x26b00 vp44OperatingConditionChecker, 0x3061a cm550_fuelLimitRestoreFromCapture, 0x30a64 cm550_protectionFlagAccumulator, 0x34534 cm550_initLoopCounter. The batch table's second caller of 0x1ca54 (vp44_evenPhaseSchedulerTaskSet 0x1b62a) is such a row inside the task set 0x1b612; there is one call (jsr at 0x1b63c). GLOBAL JUDGMENT CALLS. 0x80d284: the present name engine_protection_fuel_limit follows the record's words; fault_derate_fuel_limit is proposed only to match CM848 and the 10B1 +E neighbour. 0x80da50 / 0x80da62 get datalink_ names because J1922 handlers write them too, while the limiter keeps Tsc1 (it stamps member 20 and is CM848's twin). 0x80decc gets a neutral name; CM848's fuel_pressure_fault_fuel_limit_working is the same record. The rows 0x80a98e / 0x80a992 / 0x80a996 / 0x80a99a carry names from 107C +22.. (ASQ*), but those offsets run past block 107C into 107A (ASRFST, ASDPGN01, ASTH01DP, ASSLDP); only 0x80a98e is proposed here. JCPSDB 0x80da58 (10E8 +C JCOMM progressive shift disable) is named engine_brake_override_flag. COMMENT WORDING. The plate comments and the enum comments use the proposed global names, some of them at medium confidence (fault_derate_fuel_limit, datalink_engine_control_mode, datalink_torque_limit_fueling, fuel_system_derate_fuel_limit, wet_stack_timing_state, the trip and idle adjustment copies): if a rename is rejected its name in those comments must be put back. The CM848 absence claims were checked by mnemonic in the labelled e2m CHR_CC_11.45.01.07 (the block numbers differ between the two e2m families, so a silent block lookup proves nothing) and by address in both images and the decompilation. verdict.overall:
I re-derived all 73 proposed elements from the CM550 and CM848 disassembly, the decompilation, the e2m records and the RAM dumps. Run 1 of this task left a complete draft and I re-checked every item in it. 66 verdicts are CONFIRMED and 7 AMENDED. Only one amendment is not a comment or type fix (0x8000d6 stays untyped), and nothing is REFUTED.

FUNCTIONS. 8 twins are proved instruction by instruction: same steps, same order, same constants, same records by mnemonic, same position. They are 0xc2a0 = 0xe0c4 (16), 0xc742 = 0x502af4 (15), 0x196e4 = 0x509510 (29), 0x1ce58 = 0x1f318 (19 / 40), 0x2d9a8 = 0x2a918 (34), 0x30bf6 = 0x4279c (28), 0x30c14 = 0x427cc (20) and 0x34512 = 0x506780 (the hour meters, the last task of executive phase 0). The two chain runners (0x30c3c = cm848_processProtectionLimits), the final fueling selection 0x1c152 (= cm848_arbitrateRequestedFueling + cm848_selectFinalFueling) and the misfire step 0x26af0 are counterparts. The second chain 0x30b34 is the injection timing chain, not a fuel chain: its steps stamp the CHR SOI_State labels 11 / 1 / 13 / 3 / 4 / 5. Each batch function has exactly one caller. The 3 function amendments only drop a remark about the mid-body rows 0x1ca5c / 0x2659a / 0x26b00, which round 93 already moved to the live deleted_functions.csv; their 'was' notes are kept.

GLOBALS. Every record, access width and user was re-checked. The 0x80dc26 comment said cm550_runPowerTakeOffGovernor writes PTSS; in fact 0x2d994 reads PTSS (move.w (0x80dc26).l,(0x801c0c).l). 0x8000d6 stays 'undefined' because the unreferenced row 0x8000d7 main_loop_iteration_counter sits inside the word, in both the frozen and the live CSV. Delete that row and 'word' applies. 0x80aaa4 becomes i16: TSAJ4DTA is the only signed record of the 43. 0x801a82 becomes i16: it is sign-extended at 0x264e6 / 0x26524 and its saved copy LSICBKRF is signed.

ENUM. 17 and 33 are proved by their only stores; 18 by its only compare plus the TIT3DQTM record (I fixed the quote). 37 and 38 are renamed in both firmwares: CM848's compares show a speed control state (37 is in the all-speed governor gate) and a torque control state, and every e2m file reads T2 as Top2. 3, 36 and 39 stay unidentified. CM848's only unidentified members above 41 are 49 OFCSTATE and 50 AFRSTATE. They are only compared, as a class of air-limited states, so they stay UNIDENTIFIED. 47 is already named.

SKIPPED. 0x30b0e should stay skipped: it is a single rts with one start-up caller (0x28774) and no CM848 function at that place to compare with.

APPLY-STEP NOTES.
(1) CM848's FUELING_STATE header comment lists unidentified members (37 38 49 50); it must read (49 50). The comment of CM848 member 37 guesses a two-speed axle; the new comment replaces it.
(2) CM848 enum and plate comments that name the renamed twins need the shared names. For example, member 28 names cm848_applyFuelPressureFaultFuelLimit, and members 15 / 16 / 19 / 20 / 29 / 34 / 40 name the others.
(3) The investigator's twin plate comments are written from CM550's side ('Twin of CM848 0x...'), so keep CM848's own text on the CM848 rows.
(4) The live CSV already names final_fueling and engine_hour_meter (round 93). Round 94's sign rule already makes 0x80800a and 0x80da62 'word', the same as proposed.

LEADS OUTSIDE THE BATCH. 0x1c0d4, the torque limit to fuel conversion, is like CM848 0x1e4e8, but CM848 resets the limit in the caller. 0x1c308 is that limit's start-up initializer. 0x3452a is like cm848_loadHourMetersFromEeprom 0x5067bc. 0x16dd4 / 0x1709e are the engine warmup protection state machine and its initializer. cm848_processProtectionLimits and cm848_calculateProtectionRateLimited carry the bare word 'protection'.
